# Hero of Bitcoin

> A Game Boy-compatible adventure set in El Salvador, with 21 bitcoin hidden throughout the game.

## Digital game

- [Hero of Bitcoin Digital](https://heroofbitcoin.xyz/digital/): Instant download paid with Bitcoin or Lightning.
- [Digital release trailer](https://youtu.be/IBqAaWS--Bg): Official trailer for the digital version on YouTube.
- [Playable demo](https://demo.heroofbitcoin.xyz): Try the game before buying.

## Product facts

- The download contains the launcher for Windows (x86-64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux (x86-64), plus an English Game Boy ROM and English PDF quick-start guide.
- The launcher offers English, Dutch and Finnish. Physical game editions are in English. The landing page supports English, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, German, Korean, French, Dutch, and Finnish.
- The product page shows a live BTC amount first, with smaller USD and EUR reference prices.
- Checkout calculates the authoritative price and locks the BTC amount when it opens.
- No account or email address is required for the digital order.
